summary: Go IPC socket server satisfies AC-1..AC-9 and the contract; both prior findings verified closed on disk, branch 4 now genuinely exercised and 8/8 verify evidence recorded.
notes: contract-check ok=true; violations: none; not_checked: forbid.behaviors (evaluated by hand below).
acceptance-coverage status=pass, 9/9 AC covered by blueprint scenarios, no gaps.

Limits after the fix round: 7/7 files, 1384 insertions + 20 deletions vs max_diff_lines 2050; every per_class glob under budget (servidor.go 265/380, manejo.go 333/400, servidor_test.go 639/950, salida.go 31/60, salida_test.go 71/110, main.go 62/120, STATUS.md 3/45).

FIX 1 VERIFIED CLOSED (was: AC-7 branch 4 untested). TestEscucharStaleSocketRama4ErrorDePermisos now binds a real orphan socket inside a container dir 'caja' while it is traversable (0700), then removes its execute bit (chmod 0600). Reproduced the exact sequence in a standalone program: MkdirAll on the existing dir returns nil, net.Dial fails with EACCES (ECONNREFUSED=false, ENOENT=false), and the os.Stat fallback also fails with EACCES so os.IsNotExist=false; esConexionRechazadaONoExiste therefore returns false and branch 4 is genuinely reached. The test asserts a non-nil error that is not ErrOtroSidecarActivo AND that the pre-existing socket file survives after restoring the execute bit, which is the load-bearing no-unlink guarantee. Ran it verbosely under -race as euid 1000: RUN then PASS, not skipped.

FIX 2 VERIFIED CLOSED (was: AC-9 race evidence unrecorded). 05-validation.json now records 8/8 contract commands, the eighth being 'cd sidecar && go test -race ./internal/servidor/...' with exit_code 0; quorum validate on 05-validation.json exits 0.

Production code is byte-identical to the approved reading: servidor.go still 265 lines, manejo.go still 333, and the tracked numstat vs main is unchanged (STATUS.md 2/1, salida.go 31/0, salida_test.go 71/0, main.go 43/19). Only servidor_test.go grew, 596 -> 639. The fix round touched tests and artifacts only.
Independently re-verified the whole harness in the worktree: gofmt clean, go vet clean, go test ./... all packages ok, and go test -race -count=3 over internal/servidor and internal/outbox clean.

Fail-closed (AC-3) verified: the version check is delegated to the existing ipc.Decodificar, which compares against ipc.VersionProtocolo (4) and produces an error carrying BOTH versions ('recibida %d, esperada %d'); atenderConexion logs it and closes the connection. No re-declared wire literals anywhere, so no tautology: tests reuse ipc.Codificar and the ipc constants, and the only hand-written wire line is the deliberately malformed version-3 saludo the mismatch test needs.

Stale-socket discipline correct on all four branches: branch 2 returns ErrOtroSidecarActivo and deletes nothing (test asserts the first server's socket survives); branch 3 unlinks then binds; branch 4 returns the probe error and deletes nothing; os.Remove appears only inside branch 3. No probe-error path falls through to unlink. main.go treats any Escuchar error as terminal (os.Exit(1)).

Lifecycle: reader and writer both defer c.cerrar(), which is sync.Once-guarded (closes cerrada + conn), so the peer goroutine always unblocks at every exit path. Takeover swaps s.actual under mutex and closes the previous connection OUTSIDE the lock, as the blueprint required. The accept loop exits on s.cerrado or net.ErrClosed. A Chmod failure closes the listener, which unlinks the socket file, so no half-bound socket is left behind.

Redelivery ordering (AC-5/AC-6) correct: drenarPendientes runs inside escribirSaliente, which starts only after the sidecar's own saludo is written. Outbox payloads are ipc.Codificar output terminated with '}\n', so redelivered frames stay correctly line-delimited. Confirmation uses Outbox.Confirmar keyed by id_deduplicacion; no per-connection sequence number is used as a reference anywhere.

The server never touches the WhatsApp session on a local disconnect: deps.Sesion is referenced only for pairing (IniciarEmparejamientoQr, SolicitarCodigoDeVinculacion); Sesion.Cerrar remains exclusive to the SIGTERM/SIGINT path in main.go.

Concurrency honesty: zero time.Sleep in the new package and in the salida_test additions; takeover and disconnect are observed via EOF on a real socket, and the full wire loop synchronizes on the acuse_respaldo_sqlstore response, which establishes happens-before for the earlier confirmacion and mensaje_saliente handled by the same sequential reader.

Low-severity design observations, none breaching an AC and none blocking merge: (a) s.actual is never cleared when a connection dies on its own, so a dead conexionActiva stays referenced until the next accept, harmless because enviar() drops on the closed cerrada channel; (b) enviar()'s select can still enqueue into the 100-slot saliente buffer of a closed connection since both cases are ready, retaining at most 100 frames; (c) the shared s.trabajo channel (buffer 1) can have a signal consumed by a dying writer during takeover, self-healing because every new connection drains on connect and drenarPendientes resends the whole backlog; (d) drenarPendientes resends ALL unconfirmed entries on every work signal, legal at-least-once with id_deduplicacion dedup but amplifying traffic under a confirmation backlog; (e) the socket is created by ListenUnix and then chmod'ed to 0600, a brief window before Accept begins rather than atomic creation at 0600; (f) the branch-4 test carries an os.Geteuid() root skip, correct because root ignores permission bits, but it means that one branch's coverage silently disappears if the suite is ever run as root in CI.

Forbid behaviors checked by hand and respected: ipc/mensajes.go, the protocol doc, canal/*, outbox/{outbox,portero,transmisor}.go, configuracion, go.mod/go.sum, Cargo.* and all of crates/ are untouched; the 11-type closed set and wire version 4 are intact; no new HEXCELL_ env var, no SetDeadline and no invented timeout or backoff constant in the new package; protocol-error logs carry only the error category and field name, never the raw line or contenido (adr-0019); no mass-sending vocabulary is introduced (the single 'jitter' hit in salida.go line 332 is pre-existing context in main and is a negation); no relative dates; all new comments, log messages and STATUS.md prose are in Spanish.

AC-8 satisfied: STATUS.md gains one Definido entry dated 2026-08-13 traced to HEX-023 / tarea 3 de A-3 / FR-12, and the existing Pendiente entry 'Servidor del socket IPC en Go, ausente' is preserved verbatim with only an appended closure sentence, keeping task 15 (lab number) as the sole remaining blocker for the real end-to-end loop.
